disclosure: Supplement fixed after primary deployment results were observed; no model-update results observed before this lock. This is a controlled integration check, not independent confirmation.
hypothesis: Wrong-artifact activation can reverse a real RVL train_step loss gradient even with zero behavior-policy mismatch.
case: same-version cross-epoch prepare race, two immutable binary response records
model: torch module with logits [theta,-theta], theta=0; no pretrained model
trainer: unmodified HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer.train_step and compute_group_advantages; SGD lr=.1 injected through supported optimizer attribute; max_grad_norm=100; eps=1e-6
primary_metric: theta loss gradient vs analytic intended-B gradient, tolerance 1e-6
acceptance: base gradient has opposite sign to intended B; patched agrees with intended B and actual observed rewards; both have max_abs_log_ratio <= 1e-6; parameter displacement agrees with SGD
negative_result: Retain any mismatch; do not claim trainer impact unless analytic and source-path checks agree.
